answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: a new identity must trade with 12 unrelated counterparties, a grove, not a cloned row. Each trade is sealed with a cipher, and a prism splits each claim into 12 independent checks, so a self-trading ring is exposed. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 partners; at 5 units and 2 hours per trade, that is 6,000 units and 2,400 hours, more than any reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps its rewards undiluted.
